measure: General government sector budget aggregates: underlying cash balance, receipts (tax/non-tax), payments, gross debt, net debt, net interest payments; $b and % of GDP
source: BP1 Statement 3 Table 3.1 (DOCX table; no CSV/XLSX of the aggregates table itself)
units: A$ billion; per cent of GDP
frequency: Per budget update (Budget ~May, MYEFO ~Dec, PEFO at elections); FBO for outturn
vintage: 2026-27 Budget, 12 May 2026 (prelims). Columns: 2024-25 actual, 2025-26 to 2029-30 estimates, 4-year Total, 2036-37 projection (% GDP only)
releaseDate: Budget night; parse date from bp1_prelims.docx
transformations: Unzip DOCX, locate w:tbl after heading 'Table 3.1: Australian Government general government sector budget aggregates'
Map header row years; drop 'Total(a)' column; treat last column as % GDP medium-term projection
Strip footnote markers (a)-(e) from row labels; parse '1,051.0' style numbers; '-' as negative sign
compatibility: Underlying cash balance excludes net Future Fund earnings; not comparable with PSNB. Gross debt = face value of AGS on issue; net debt uses market value. Cash basis; accrual equivalents in Table 3.7.
failure: Reject if Table 3.1 heading missing, year header not contiguous financial years, row set changes, or non-numeric cells. Keep last verified payload.
validation: Verified 2026-10-12: UCB 2025-26 -28.3 / 2026-27 -31.5; gross debt 2026-27 1,051.0 (34.0% GDP); net debt 616.6 (19.9%); net interest 19.9 (0.6%). Live run 2026-10-12: identities payments-receipts=-UCB within $0.15b; $b/GDP vs published % within 0.06pp; Table 3.1 % vs chart data within 0.05pp (max 0.044).
licence: CC BY 4.0 (budget.gov.au legal notices; BP1 imprint). Attribute '© Commonwealth of Australia'. Coat of Arms/Budget logo/third-party excluded.

implementation.notes: Two layouts parsed: Budget (value row + "Per cent of GDP" row, Actual/Estimates/Projections groups via gridSpan) and MYEFO (MYEFO/PEFO/Budget sub-rows; MYEFO rows used). Publication date confirmed from bp1_prelims.docx ("12 May 2026") and the MYEFO archive page ("released on Wednesday 17 December 2025"); otherwise the refresh fails. After the 2027-28 Budget the 2026-27 files move to archive.budget.gov.au and the URLs need updating.

measure: Budget Papers chart data incl. UCB/receipts/payments/gross & net debt % GDP to 2036-37 (Budget vs prior MYEFO vs 2022 PEFO vs historical), structural budget balance decomposition
source: Budget Papers chart data ZIP of XLSX (bp1-bs2..bs10.xlsx, bp3, bp4, wbs) + Statement 5 receipts CSVs
units: per cent of GDP (most series); $b for some
frequency: Per budget update; MYEFO equivalent e.g. https://archive.budget.gov.au/2025-26/myefo/download/myefo-2025-26-chart-data.zip
vintage: 2026-27 Budget; sheet 3.4 = UCB, 3.9 = gross debt, 3.12 = net debt, 3.14 = structural budget balance (2016-17 to 2036-37). Sheet numbering differs by edition (MYEFO 2025-26: C3.10 = structural).
transformations: Select sheet by header text (e.g. 'Structural budget balance'), never by sheet number
Row 1 is 'Website Chart Data'; row 2 header; columns positional with empty-string cells for absent vintages
Retain each vintage column (Budget, MYEFO, PEFO, Historical) separately
compatibility: Chart data are rounded to 0.1 ppt; projections beyond forward estimates are medium-term projections, not forecasts.
failure: Reject if expected header strings absent or year column malformed.

implementation.notes: Sheets located by caption text in the statement DOCX ("Chart 3.x: Underlying cash balance" etc.), restricted to the statement workbook (bp1-bs3 / part-3) and to the sheet that carries both the vintage column and a Historical column (excludes the 3.10/3.11 yield scenarios). Multi-row headers are flattened (group forward-filled). Medium-term years go to vintage.projections. 2022 and 2025 PEFO columns are not imported.

measure: Structural budget balance, cyclical factors, temporary fiscal measures (% GDP)
source: BP1 Statement 3 Chart 3.14 chart data (XLSX in ZIP); methodology Treasury Working Paper 2013-01
transformations: UCB = structural + cyclical + temporary measures (check identity within 0.1 rounding)
compatibility: Treasury cash-basis structural balance; not comparable with OBR cyclically-adjusted PSNB. No published output gap series in BP1 data.
failure: Reject if identity fails by >0.2 ppt or columns renamed.

implementation.fields: structuralBalancePct, cyclicalFactorsPct, temporaryMeasuresPct (published); structuralBorrowingPct = -structural; structuralBorrowingBn and structuralPrimaryBalancePct derived. Identity checked within 0.15pp. History rows from 2016-17 use the 2026-27 Budget estimates.

measure: Nominal GDP levels (Budget vs prior MYEFO) and domestic economic forecasts (real/nominal GDP growth, CPI, WPI, unemployment, terms of trade)
source: Nominal GDP XLSX (online only) + BP1 Statement 2 Table 2.2 (DOCX)
units: A$ million (nominal GDP level); per cent change, fractions like '2 1/4' (Table 2.2)
vintage: 2026-27 Budget: nominal GDP 2020-21 to 2036-37; Table 2.2 2024-25 outcome + 2025-26 to 2027-28 forecasts
transformations: Parse quarter-point fractions ('2 1/4', '- 1/4') to decimals in Table 2.2
compatibility: Nominal GDP denominator for all %GDP ratios.
failure: Reject non-monotonic years or missing Budget column.

implementation.notes: Budget Table 2.2 / MYEFO Table 2.3 (MYEFO sub-columns). realGdpGrowth, nominalGdpGrowth, inflation (CPI through-year June qtr), wagePriceIndexGrowth, gdpDeflatorGrowth, unemploymentRate. Nominal GDP levels from bp1_s2-data-nominal-GDP.xlsx (Budget and MYEFO columns) are the gdpBn denominator.

measure: Cash receipts by head of revenue (and accrual revenue), $m and % GDP, 2005-06 to 2029-30
units: A$ million; per cent of GDP (t2, t4)
frequency: Per budget (filename statement number varies: 2025-26 used bp1_s4-online_t1.csv)
transformations: Strip UTF-8 BOM/leading space in first column

provider: Australian Treasury (BP1 Statement 11) / Parliamentary Budget Office
measure: Long-run historical UCB, receipts, payments, net debt, net interest, AGS on issue (Treasury tables from 1970-71); PBO Historical Fiscal Data workbook
source: BP1 Statement 11 DOCX tables 11.1-11.11; PBO XLSX 'Historical Fiscal Data: 2026-27 Budget'
units: A$ million; per cent of GDP
transformations: Treasury: parse DOCX tables, continued tables split across pages
compatibility: Series breaks noted in Statement 11 footnotes (accrual from 1999-00).
failure: PBO site not reachable by scripted HTTP from this environment (timeouts/HTTP2 INTERNAL_ERROR); prefer Treasury DOCX.
validation: Treasury Table 11.1 2010-11 UCB -47,463 $m (-3.3% GDP) verified. PBO workbook NOT fetched (inferred from search snippet).
licence: Treasury CC BY 4.0; PBO licence not verified (PBO generally CC BY 4.0; older data.gov.au mirrors CC BY-NC-ND 3.0 AU).

implementation.status: implemented (Treasury Statement 11 only; PBO not used)
implementation.notes: Tables 11.1, 11.3, 11.4, 11.5 incl. continued tables, 1970-71 to latest actual. Receipts include net Future Fund earnings in 2005-06 to 2019-20 (flag receiptsIncludeFutureFundEarnings, identity checked either way to $2.5m). GDP before 2020-21 implied from receipts / receipts-to-GDP.

measure: Government Economic and Fiscal Strategy (Charter of Budget Honesty Act 1998) - qualitative objectives
units: n/a (qualitative objectives; related official paths only)
transformations: Quote Box 3.1 overarching goal and the listed actions verbatim

Attach official forecast/projection paths per objective (gross debt % GDP peak and end; UCB first year at or above zero; payments % GDP; payments real growth from Statement 11). No pass/fail verdicts, headroom or targets.
compatibility: No legislated numeric targets. The dashboard does not assess compliance.
failure: Refresh fails if the Box 3.1 overarching-goal sentence (reduce gross debt as a share of the economy over time) is not found, or fewer than 3 / more than 10 actions are found.

measure: Tax Expenditures and Insights Statement: revenue forgone per tax expenditure
source: TEIS chart data XLSX sheet 'Revenue forgone estimates' (Code, Title, 8 years); metadata (type, functional category, reliability, prior code, * order-of-magnitude category, legislative reference) only in DOCX/PDF Appendix A.1
frequency: Annual (2025-26 edition published 17 December 2025, alongside MYEFO)
vintage: 2025-26 TEIS: 2021-22 to 2028-29 (actuals/estimates/projections); 304 tax expenditures, codes A (personal) B (business) C (super) D E (capital gains) F G H (GST)
transformations: Codes: '-' nil, '..' rounded to zero, '*' unquantifiable, 'nfp' not for publication -> null with status flag
Join DOCX Appendix A.1 metadata on Code (parse 'Estimate Reliability:', 'Tax expenditure type:', '2024-25 code:', '* Category:')
Do not sum across tax expenditures (interactions; Treasury caveat)
compatibility: Revenue-forgone method, no behavioural response; benchmarks differ from HMRC reliefs. Codes renumber between editions (use '2024-25 code' crosswalk).
failure: Reject if header row != Code, Title, consecutive years, or code count changes >10%.
validation: Verified: 304 rows; H25 Food 2025-26 = 9,900 $m; status counts '*' 1175, '-' 123, '..' 91, 'nfp' 4 cells. Live run 2026-10-12: 304 items joined; all 2,432 cells match the appendix; 6 items 'Included in' another code; 2025-26 largest: E8 Main residence exemption - discount component 32,000; C2 employer super contributions 29,450; E7 main residence exemption 28,000; C4 super earnings 25,950; E15 CGT discount 21,790.
licence: CC BY 4.0 (stated in TEIS imprint), © Commonwealth of Australia.

implementation.editionUpdate: No Treasury listing page for TEIS editions could be fetched (treasury.gov.au search redirects; candidate index URLs 404). The edition is therefore pinned: the adapter fetches the pinned publication page, requires its <title> to name this edition, takes publication date from the page datetime and the xlsx/docx links from the page. A new edition (usually December, with MYEFO) needs PAGE/EDITION/TITLE/FIRST_PROJECTION updated in pipeline/au/teis.py and here.
implementation.join: Workbook (Code, Title, 8 years) joined to DOCX Appendix A.1 on code; every cell must match the appendix value (merged appendix cells "Included in X" map to workbook "-" as status "included elsewhere"). Category counts must equal Table A1.1. taxHead = Table A1.1 category; functionalCategory = estimate table heading; type, reliability, 2024-25 code, * Category (order of magnitude), commencement, expiry, legislative reference from the metadata table.
implementation.aggregation: aggregate.costMillion is null (no official total). derivedTotals and superannuation.totals sum numeric estimates only and count excluded statuses; nothing is imputed.
